name: Homepage
description: A start page for a server: bookmarks, service tiles and widgets, all from YAML files in its config volume. It is published with its own sign-in gate on, so the password generated here is what opens it.

access.note: Homepage asks for a password and no user name, so the generated password here is the whole credential and everyone who uses the page shares it. Reveal it from the Variables tab and paste it into the sign-in form the address opens on.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: The address other people open. Sign-in needs it too: Homepage refuses to start with the gate on and no address to sign cookies for.

update.notes: Configuration files carry over between versions.

secrets.name: auth-password
secrets.label: Sign-in password
secrets.description: The whole credential: Homepage asks for a password and no user name.

secrets.name: auth-secret
secrets.label: Session signing key
secrets.description: Signs the sign-in cookie. Changing it signs everyone out.
